about: Public tutorials from makers' own docs and channels, linked to the products they cover and the chain part they help with. Fields: id, title (the page's own title), title_display (generated by scripts/titles.ts from covers, publisher and part; never hand-written), url, creator, publisher (the service id of the maker who wrote it, when that maker is one of covers; else null), language, kind (article or video), published (when the page states a date), checked_on, covers (service ids the guide is about, at least one), part (chain parts: camera, sender, connections, receiver, obs, platform; the first decides the title and the group), words and answers (ids it helps with). Links only.
